name: 薄荷健康
description: fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
text:
#!name=薄荷健康
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = api.boohee.com, bohe.sfo-tx-shanghai-01.saas.sensorsdata.cn, lego.boohee.com, status.boohee.com

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/meta-interface\/v1\/index\/page_float_bubbles\?/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/meta-interface\/v1\/index\/tool_buttons\?/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/app-interface\/v1\/search\/search\?/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/status\.boohee\.com\/api\/v1\/merged_messages$/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/bohe\.sfo-tx-shanghai-01\.saas\.sensorsdata\.cn\/api\/v2\/sfo\/user_popup_configs\?/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/meta-interface\/v1\/index\/sensor-banners\?/i then reject_dict(200)

[Script]
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/meta-interface\/v2\/index\?/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/bohe/bohe_ads.js") with enable=${bohejmkh_enable}, tag="薄荷健康", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/meta-interface\/v1\/index\/plaza\?/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/bohe/bohe_ads.js") with enable=${bohejmkh_enable}, tag="薄荷健康", timeout=60, requires_body=true
response if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/api\.boohee\.com\/open-interface\/v1\/string\/market_page\?title=metabolism_config$/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/bohe/bohe_ads.js") with enable=${bohejmkh_enable}, tag="薄荷健康", timeout=60, requires_body=true
